summary: Iter12 backend regression PASSED (11/11). Verified: (1) server.py env-driven defaults now match user admin (deb@agrocorp.co.in / Admin@Agro@2026# / Agrocorp Admin) with no lingering Vista defaults; (2) startup self-heal reactivates a deactivated admin AND clears stale login_attempts entry on next boot; (3) seed idempotency — a user-changed password survives restart (not overwritten by ADMIN_TEMP_PASSWORD); (4) startup safe when login_attempts doc missing (delete_one is a no-op); (5) e2e login returns access_token + must_reset_password=True. Iter11 lockout regression (6 tests) still fully passing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2539 lines — should be split into modules (auth/users/projects/etc) per the file-size guideline (>700).

Startup self-heal only clears lockout for ADMIN_EMAIL. If a non-admin user gets locked in prod and their env-driven admin is different, they still need /forgot-password. Acceptable — documented recovery path.
ADMIN_TEMP_PASSWORD default is hardcoded in source. Acceptable for preview but ensure production sets its own env var to avoid known-default risk (documented in test_credentials.md).
startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler (non-blocking, tracking only).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin. Test 3 temporarily rotated admin password to verify idempotency, then restored ADMIN_TEMP_PASSWORD hash. Final DB state: admin active, must_reset_password=true, ADMIN_TEMP_PASSWORD active, no lockout entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter12 verified auth self-heal + code defaults. Tests restart the backend (via sudo supervisorctl) 3 times — that is expected. Both test files (iter11 lockout + iter12 seed/self-heal) are the current auth regression suite; run them after any auth/startup changes.
rca of the issue: Production login for deb@agrocorp.co.in failed because previous server.py hardcoded old Vista defaults; on Emergent K8s prod .env isn't loaded so os.environ.get() defaults kicked in and seeded the OLD admin. Fix confirmed: defaults switched to deb@agrocorp.co.in/Admin@Agro@2026#/Agrocorp Admin and startup now reactivates + clears lockout for the configured admin on every boot. When user redeploys prod, the missing deb@agrocorp.co.in user will be auto-seeded on next startup.
